title: Design: Customer chip shortens a long name and the toolbar stays on one line
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the asset's owner.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, a payer, with a long name with no spaces that no other customer has, at least 50 characters (for example NorthernPlainsHeavyTruckandTrailerRepairServicesWest).
  • If a name field stops before the end of a name, use the longest name it takes.
  • Have a new asset for this test, asset 1, owned by customer A, with work order 1 for customer A billed to customer B and work order 2 for customer A billing itself, both at the test location.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p7-04-after-one-customer-picked.png, bt-p7-05-after-applied.png, bt-p7-07-after-1600-wide-search-s2-16.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open asset 1's Work Orders tab from customer A's page.
  2. Click the "Customer" filter chip.
  3. Tick customer B.
  4. Click outside the panel.
  5. Resize the browser window to 1536 pixels wide.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 and work order 2 are listed.

Step 2:

  • The panel opens.

Step 3:

  • Customer B is ticked and the chip reads "Customer: " and the start of customer B's name, shortened with "...".

Step 4:

  • The panel closes and only work order 1 is listed.
  • The search box, Status, the Customer chip and New sit on one line; nothing wraps and New is fully visible at the right.

Step 5:

  • The search box, Status, the Customer chip and New still sit on one line, with New fully visible.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12316 (Story 14, Asset Work Orders tab: whole history and Customer filter)

  • S14-R2: “A "Customer" filter chip sits beside Status, defaulting to "All customers".”
  • S14-R4: “The filter is multi-select; a work order matches when a picked customer is its customer or its Bill To.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794510417-a68d (its boards are byte-identical to version 1794239066-4906 read 9 Nov 2026), read 13 Nov 2026: pictures "One customer picked" (page 7 "Asset Work Orders tab", New, no before exists), "Applied" (page 7 "Asset Work Orders tab", New, no before exists), "1600 wide, search "S2-16"" (page 7 "Asset Work Orders tab", This build). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p7-04-after-one-customer-picked.png
  • bt-p7-05-after-applied.png
  • bt-p7-07-after-1600-wide-search-s2-16.png

The design's own words:

  • “Quartzsite ticked: "1 selected", and the chip reads "Customer: Quartzsite Truc...".”
  • “Searching the whole history finds Kolosov's S2-16894 as well. The search box, Status, Customer chip and New sit on one line at 1600; nothing wraps.”

The PRD does not say how a long name shows in the chip; the "..." and the one-line toolbar come from the design's own pictures (its words above). The design draws the chip with an ordinary name only; the long name without spaces follows the design-case checklist (lesson L-21).
